name: Shamosaurus
sum: Shamosaurus is a basal ankylosaurid from the Early Cretaceous of Mongolia, known from a skull and cervical half rings.
holotype: PIN N 3779/2, a skull and two cervical half rings — Dzunbain Formation, Hamrin-Us, Dornogovi, Mongolia.
biology: Basal ankylosaurid; the sources used give no behavioural data.
author: Tumanova 1983

sources.text: T. A. Tumanova. 1983. Pervyy ankilozavr iz nizhnego mela Mongolii [The first ankylosaurs from the Lower Cretaceous of Mongolia]. In L. P. Tatarinov, R. Barsbold, E. Vorobyeva, B.
